lines.zh: 背上袋囊一摇一晃，满地脓迹。
lines.en: Sloshing sack sends slimy trails.
Legs step through decayed earth.
Beware the sticky ooze.
Slow but deadly, I move.
Spew goo to stick foes.
Sack pulses, ready to spew.
Goo masks my footsteps.
I guard this domain.
Goo balls roll from me.

lines.zh: 恶心的分泌物黏附四周。
lines.en: Repellent ooze sticks around.
My spider legs cross the flesh plains.
The pus in my sac sloshes with each step.
Goo waits in sack.
Silent vigil over all.
Waiting for prey.
I hide in shadows.
Sack ready to spew.
The pus sac on my back is full.
Next victim, I wait.
Sack is always full.
Awaiting all to consume.
Await, then spew stench.
I lie still inside the pile of rot.
The sac on my back swells and settles.
No one disturbs me on the bone wastes.
I wait for prey to step into the pus pool.
Player scent, detected.

lines.zh: 这里不是活人该来的地方。
lines.en: This is no place for the living.

lines.zh: 再走一步，我就把脓喷出去。
lines.en: One more step and I spray my pus.
Player, you're paralyzed.
My goo will work now.
Player, you're queasy.
Wrap you up now.

lines.zh: 你的呕吐物马上就要出现了。
lines.en: Your vomit will come.
Player, you're poisoned.
You stepped into my pus pool.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸带着活人的味道。
lines.en: Your breath smells of the living.
Do not cover your nose, it is too late.
The sac on my back knows you.
Pus spots are already on you.
One more step and I spray your face.
The flesh plains welcome the living.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声惊动了脓袋。
lines.en: Your footsteps woke the pus sac.

lines.zh: 看着你，我的脓液沸腾了。
lines.en: Watching you, my pus starts to boil.
Player, your stomach is turning.
I spray when I count to three.
Slosh, ouch!
Wounded, ouch!
The pus sac on my back has been pierced.
This hurts...

lines.zh: 脓袋漏了，地上冒起白烟。
lines.en: The sac leaks, and white smoke rises from the ground.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了两条，爬不动了。
lines.en: Two of my legs are broken; I cannot crawl.

lines.zh: 背上裂了道口子，脓在往外流。
lines.en: A gash opens on my back; pus runs out.
Please... save me!
My life!

lines.zh: 脓水溅出来，我自己也烫伤。
lines.en: Pus splashes out and burns even me.

lines.zh: 贪婪的触手缠上你，恶心感随之而来。
lines.en: Greedy tentacles grab you, followed by nausea.

lines.zh: 脓袋膨胀，即将爆裂，恶心你。
lines.en: The pus sack inflates, about to burst and nauseate.
Come closer, nauseate you for twelve seconds.

lines.zh: 触手沾满脓液，准备攻击。
lines.en: Tentacles drenched in pus, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 你感受到我的存在，恶心感随之而来。
lines.en: You feel my presence, nausea follows.

lines.zh: 毒素从我身体喷出，你开始反胃。
lines.en: Toxins spew from my body, making you nauseous.

lines.zh: 你被我的气味吸引，却感到恶心。
lines.en: You're drawn to my smell, but feel nauseated.

lines.zh: 我的触手触及你，你会反胃。
lines.en: My tentacles touch you, causing nausea.

lines.zh: 我体内脓液即将喷出，恶心你。
lines.en: The pus within me is about to burst, nauseating you.
Get closer, to make you nauseous.

lines.zh: 触手缠绕，阻碍你的路径。
lines.en: Tentacles wrap around, blocking your path.

lines.zh: 你的碰触让我喷出脓液。
lines.en: Your touch causes pus to spew.

lines.zh: 我的触手撞上你，带来恶心感。
lines.en: My tentacles collide with you, causing nausea.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的身体，恶心你。
lines.en: You bump into me, nauseating you.

lines.zh: 我的触手阻挡你，带来不适。
lines.en: My tentacles block you, causing discomfort.

lines.zh: 触手缠绕，使你无法动弹。
lines.en: Tentacles ensnare you, immobilizing you.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的脓袋，恶心你。
lines.en: You hit my pus sack, making you nauseous.

lines.zh: 我的触手阻挡你，带来恶心。
lines.en: My tentacles block you, causing nausea.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的身体，恶心感袭来。
lines.en: You hit my body, nausea follows.

lines.zh: 我的触手缠绕你，带来不适。
lines.en: My tentacles wrap around you, causing discomfort.
Come close, feel my warmth.
Tentacles wrap, my mate.
Come near, feel my closeness.

lines.zh: 我的触手触碰你，成为伴侣。
lines.en: My tentacles touch you, becoming a mate.
Come to me, my mate.
Tentacles wrap, become a mate.

lines.zh: 我的触手缠绕你，你就是我的伴侣。
lines.en: My tentacles wrap around you, you're my mate.
Come near, feel my intimacy.
Tentacles gently touch, my mate.
Come to me, become my mate.

lines.zh: 脓液一滴一滴落在我脚边。
lines.en: Pus drips by my feet, drop by drop.
Mine to keep.
Foul delicacy.
Try my offering.

lines.zh: 我把脓袋往背上又顶了顶。
lines.en: I hitch the pus sac higher on my back.
Viscous gift.
Your feast.
Putrid taste.
The sac is full. Stop stuffing it.

lines.zh: 我抱着这块腐肉，慢慢啃。
lines.en: I clutch this rotten flesh and gnaw slowly.

lines.zh: 背上的脓袋开始鼓起来。
lines.en: The sac on my back begins to swell.
Toxins flow.
Come closer, corrupt.
Feel my curse.
Prepare to accept.
Eight eyes fix on you at once.
Approach death.
Fear, mortal.
This is your end.
Living warmth, found.
That body belongs to my pus.
The smell of flesh cannot run.
You were doomed the moment you entered the bone wastes.

lines.zh: 我的袋子已经鼓到极限。
lines.en: My sac is swollen to its limit.
My prey will vomit within twelve seconds.
I have you; you cannot wipe the pus off.
Aim, prepare.
Toxic cloud ready.
The pus sac on my back is full.
Feel death's breath.
Corruption descends.
Pain follows.

lines.zh: 我背上的脓袋，一碰就喷。
lines.en: Touch the pus sack on my back and it sprays.
Toxic spew imminent.
Death approaches.

lines.zh: 我的脓液已经对准你了。
lines.en: My pus is already aimed at you.
The sac contracts and the countdown starts.

lines.zh: 我在计算你呕吐的时间。
lines.en: I am counting the seconds until you retch.

lines.zh: 毒素已经顺着空气过去。
lines.en: The toxin is already drifting through the air.
My sac is swollen. It is about to burst.
My spout is aimed at your face.
The nausea will bring you to your knees.
Twelve seconds is enough to reach you.
The pus rolls over inside my sac.

lines.zh: 背上的脓袋一晃，就要喷。
lines.en: My pus sac shifts; it's about to burst.
I aim for your stomach, not your face.
Slimy spore burst!
Ghastly spore spray!
Toxic spores rain!
Spew corruption!
Toxic mists spread!
Spore sack ruptures!
Gross attack!
Corrupted chunks!
Too close!
Spore kiss of death!
Pus splashes all over you!
Spout aimed, everything goes out!
One mouthful of this will keep you retching!
My sac has burst open!
A chunk of rotten flesh slams down beside your feet!
Poison mist wraps around your head!
Spawn in decay!
Rise in darkness!
Spore wait!
Spawn of darkness!
Spawn in rot!
Spore surge!
Spawned flesh!
Spawned here!
Await in spores!
Spawn in decay!
A pus blister rises on the flesh plains.
A pus-filled seam splits the bone wastes.
I crawl out of the heap of rot.
Beneath the bedrock, a pus sac takes shape.

lines.zh: 失落文明的污水养大我。
lines.en: The lost civilization's filth raised me.

lines.zh: 又一袋脓液在这片荒原诞生。
lines.en: Another sac of pus is born on this waste.
I squeeze out from under the bone heap.

lines.zh: 这片腐烂之地该有主人了。
lines.en: This rotting land needs a master.
A pus ball rolls down and here I am.
The scent of flesh called me here.
The fire boils the pus inside me!
I hit the ground and my sac leaks.
The water thins out my pus.
The blast burst half of my sac!
An arrow pierced my pus sac!
Magic scorches the pus inside me!
I am so hungry my sac has gone flat.
Lightning struck my sac and it smokes!
The void is sucking the pus out of me.
